name.description: Theme name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. "acme"

brand.description: Any CSS colour, e.g. oklch(62% 0.19 255) or #2563eb

accent.description: Any CSS colour, e.g. oklch(62% 0.19 255) or #2563eb

neutral.description: Any CSS colour, e.g. oklch(62% 0.19 255) or #2563eb

seeds.description: Seed colours; every palette step and semantic token is derived from them

colorScheme.description: Schemes the theme must serve; contrast is checked for these ("both", the default, adds the high-contrast theme)

font.description: Body font stack (system fonts, nothing is downloaded)

level.description: WCAG level every text and UI colour pair must meet, default AA (seed palettes always meet AA)

strict.description: Fail with NB_CONTRAST_FAIL instead of adjusting colours that miss the level
